releases.title: Actual Cost Basis, MeroShare Connect Fixes, Import Redesign, and Area Charts
highlights: Actual Cost Basis: Stock details now compute a fee-inclusive average cost per transaction - NEPSE brokerage slabs, SEBON fee and DP charges for market buys, NAV + DPS charge for SIP installments, allotment price only for IPO/bonus - with tap-to-toggle against the market average and a real Total Investment figure.
MeroShare Connect Reliability: Fixed a race condition that silently erased newly connected MeroShare accounts from settings; account linking now always writes the authoritative account list.
Import Flow Redesign: Simplified Import Data dialog with an Import CSV card, an 'or' divider, and an inline row showing the linked account name with Sync and Unlink actions.
Explicit Account Choice: Connecting never auto-links silently - existing accounts are listed in a picker with a 'Use a different account' option to add fresh credentials.
Area Chart Upgrades: Gradient-filled area charts now power stock price analysis, the NEPSE intraday sparkline, and the Market & Movers intraday graph.

Mobile Polish: One-row stat tiles and compact Best Entry/Exit cards in price analysis, News moved into the overview action row on mobile, edge-to-edge NEPSE card chart, smaller portfolio summary text, and compact SIP badge that hides the year when it is the current year.

UI Fixes: Sold Stocks toggle stays readable in light and dark modes across hover/press states, fixed double-sign display (+0) in sold mode with a neutral zero state, renamed MeroLagani button to Details, and PIN keypad keeps focus after wrong entries.
Housekeeping: Removed graphify-out build artifacts from the repository and added it to .gitignore.

releases.title: Document Vault, SIP History Import, Bulk LTP, and PDF Preview System
highlights: Personal Document Vault: Encrypted document storage with AES-GCM, person-based organization, auto-detection of document types (citizenship, passport, license), and full CRUD via IndexedDB.
Document Viewer & Preview: In-app viewer with zoom, page navigation, full-screen mode, PDF/blob URL rendering, and thumbnail generation via pdfjs.
SIP History Import: Upload XLSX/XLS/CSV files to import SIP transaction history directly into portfolio tracking.
Bulk LTP History API: New endpoint fetching historical price data for multiple symbols simultaneously with configurable month range (up to 120 months).
Rhododendron Emblem: Decorative Lali Gurans flower watermark on balance cards as a Nepali brand touch.
Stock Exchange PDF Preview: Replaced broken @react-pdf-viewer with iframe-based blob URL rendering for reliable document viewing, with domain-whitelist security.
Dev Settings Protection: Development configuration tab hidden from normal users - only visible in dev mode or localhost.
Version Bump: Transitioned to 2.1.1.1 with continued IndexedDB migration and record-level sync engine work.

releases.title: Public Pages, Settings Overhaul, Portfolio Heatmap, Debt Redesign, and Insights Smart Advisor
highlights: Public Pages Suite: About page with story, stats, timeline, and creator profile. Features catalog showcasing 45+ capabilities with shared glassmorphism layout and navigation.

Settings Module Overhaul: Replaced monolithic modal with tabbed desktop layout and full-screen mobile settings. Custom theme editor with color picker, audio feedback system with per-activity sounds and upload, screen reader and accessibility controls, font size slider, and Nepali/International number formatting.
Portfolio Heatmap View: Treemap-based portfolio visualization with squarified layout algorithm, search, asset/sizing/color mode filters, pin-to-detail, hover tooltip, and info dialog.
IPO Detail Modal: Full IPO detail view with timeline, stats, and inline MeroShare apply/check allotment. Smart button adapts to IPO status with credential validation before actions.

Debt & Credit Management Redesign: Tabbed layout (Debt/Lending/Credit/History) with summary cards, collapsible accounts, payoff projections, fast debt auto-classification, archive support, and custom date range picker.

Insights Smart Advisor: Financial health hero with score circle, grade, and description. Smart Advisor feed with 10 dynamic insight types, one-click auto-create actions, core metrics grid, and JSON export report.
Broker Leaderboard with Podium: Hero podium section with crown/medal/award icons and animated columns. Daily sort option, rank badges, and BS-aware amount formatting.
Budget & Goal List Enhancements: Budget sort/filter/bulk operations with history dialog. Goal tabs layout with progress visualization and scenario planning. Custom date range pickers.
Balance Card Consolidation: Consolidated balance card component with net worth carousel, swipe/touch support, income/expense monthly vs all-time toggle, and localStorage theme customization.

releases.title: Public Roadmap, Returning User Recovery, Portfolio Snapshots, MeroShare Automation, and Budget Refinements
highlights: Public Roadmap: Shipped a dedicated public roadmap with current features, searchable goals, milestone tracking, bento feature showcase, and completed/in-progress/planned visibility.
MeroShare Automation: Added Browserless WebSocket support to delegate automated IPO checks and applications to remote cloud browsers.
Extension Bridge: Integrated a global extension bridge in the root layout to seamlessly sync wallet state with the MyWallet Chrome/Firefox companion extension.
Dropbox & Security: Upgraded sync flows to remember backup PINs, validate OAuth scopes, and revoke active tokens on disconnect.
Portfolio Workflows: Enriched views with grouped price histories, sell previews, dividend what-if planning, live value previews, and transaction drafts.
Budget Boundaries: Fixed transaction periods to begin on the 1st day of active months/weeks, and replaced the washed-out exceeded budget UI with premium red-bordered dark glow states.

Goal & Challenge Refinement: Consolidated expanded goals into a clean Key Metrics Grid, restored Hard Plan Point/Penalty tracking with 'Use for Investment' actions, and stabilized transaction history scrolls.
Welcome Back Flow: Returning users who land on the welcome page now see a clear welcome-back message and a direct path back to the dashboard.
Active Development: Designing storage migration from localStorage to IndexedDB, record-level synchronization, and cryptographic data rotation rules.

releases.title: Dropbox Cleanup, Notification Controls, and Floating Calculator
highlights: Disconnecting Dropbox now revokes the active token when possible and clears all local Dropbox backup keys.
Added missing Dropbox scope detection so users are guided to reconnect when backup permissions are incomplete.
Added compact notification actions for bill reminders, notification settings, mark-all-read, and clearing live notifications.
Upgraded the floating calculator with keyboard input, live results, movable desktop windows, docking, multiple instances, and a tabbed history view.

Improved stock news document titles with character limits and URL decoding.
Added conditional work time estimation display based on user settings.

releases.title: Comprehensive Wealth Flow & Accurate Expense Tracking

Integrated Portfolio & IPO activity into daily summaries: Stock/Crypto buys and IPO applications are now factored into total expenses.
Included debt repayments in the global expense calculations for a complete picture of wealth flow.
Optimized Balance Card performance with improved memoization and explicit TypeScript safety.
